critical_code_review_comments: index.html remains ~5678 lines — still well past the 700-line guideline. The hydration merge logic (preserve testid by URL match) is a good pattern but should be extracted to a shared module in /assets/js/.

Client-side URL rewriting of the Scorecard sister-site loc to the local /publications/... path is a workaround; long term the /api/headlines source-of-truth should own the canonical URL to avoid drift if the frontend HTML is served from a CDN cache.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_6 hydration bugs are fully resolved. Hero brief and press-citations both preserve data-testid via URL-match merge and force the HNR/Scorecard row to position #0. Backend /api/press/citations now includes HNR at index 0; /api/headlines still returns sister-site URL but frontend rewrites it client-side to /publications/vision-2030-scorecard.html as designed. Citations counter shows 24 (aligned with live API, per updated review spec).
